description: This file implements the 'git reflog' command functionalities, including subcommands like show, list, exists, write, delete, drop, and expire. It handles reflog management operations within a Git repository, such as viewing, listing, checking existence, writing new entries, deleting, dropping, and expiring reflog entries. The code includes definitions of usage documentation, subcommand implementations, callback functions for reflog expiration, and command dispatching logic.

methods.name: int collect_reflog(const char * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Collects reflog references from a worktree, avoiding duplicates for shared refs.

methods.name: int expire_unreachable_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback to handle '--expire-unreachable' option in reflog expiry.

methods.name: int expire_total_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback to handle '--expire' option in reflog expiry.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog show' subcommand, displaying reflog entries for a given ref.

methods.name: int show_reflog(const char * refname,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Callback to print reflog reference names.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog list' subcommand, listing all reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_expire(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog expire' subcommand, pruning reflog entries based on criteria.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_delete(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog delete' subcommand, deleting specified reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_exists(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog exists' subcommand, checking if a reflog exists for a ref.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_drop(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog drop' subcommand, dropping reflogs for references.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_write(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'reflog write' subcommand, writing a new reflog entry.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repository)
methods.description: Main dispatcher for 'git reflog' command, dispatching to subcommands.
